component.name: SigProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.result = "<not-called>" m.trig = 0
m.cases = [ { id: "A_noargs", cb: "cbA", sig: "sub cbA()" } { id: "B_dynamic1", cb: "cbB", sig: "sub cbB(e)" } { id: "C_objectReq", cb: "cbC", sig: "sub cbC(e as object)" } { id: "D_dynamicReq", cb: "cbD", sig: "sub cbD(e as dynamic)" } { id: "E_stringReq", cb: "cbE", sig: "sub cbE(s as string)" } { id: "F_stringDef", cb: "cbF", sig: "sub cbF(s = update as string)" } { id: "G_intReq", cb: "cbG", sig: "sub cbG(n as integer)" } { id: "H_intDef", cb: "cbH", sig: "sub cbH(n = 42 as integer)" } { id: "I_evtPlusOpt", cb: "cbI", sig: "sub cbI(e, opt = true)" } { id: "J_twoReq", cb: "cbJ", sig: "sub cbJ(a, b)" } { id: "K_strDefObjDef", cb: "cbK", sig: "sub cbK(s = update as string, e = invalid as object)" } { id: "L_boolReq", cb: "cbL", sig: "sub cbL(b as boolean)" } { id: "M_objThenStrDef", cb: "cbM", sig: "sub cbM(e as object, s = update as string)" } { id: "N_objDef", cb: "cbN", sig: "sub cbN(e = invalid as object)" } { id: "O_function", cb: "cbO", sig: "function cbO(e as object) as string" } { id: "P_objThenStrReq", cb: "cbP", sig: "sub cbP(e as object, s as string)" } ]
m.reg = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "sigprobe") m.stepTimer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.caseTimer = m.top.findNode("caseTimer")
p("all", "start", "cases=" + itos(m.cases.count()))
' Synchronous phases: the observer runs inside the field write, so a try/catch around the ' write can report an invocation-time error instead of taking the app down. runFieldPhase("p1-observeField", false, "probeTrigger", []) runFieldPhase("p3-scopedObserve", true, "probeTrigger", []) runFieldPhase("p4-stringField", false, "probeTriggerStr", ["B_dynamic1", "C_objectReq", "E_stringReq", "F_stringDef"])
' Asynchronous phase: a Timer `fire` observer runs from the render-thread message loop, ' outside any try/catch we can install, so this one is checkpointed in the registry. m.p2 = ckpt("p2next") m.p2pending = false m.stepTimer.observeField("fire", "onStep") m.stepTimer.control = "start" end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Phase drivers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sub runFieldPhase(phase as string, scoped as boolean, fieldName as string, only as object) key = phase + "-next" start = ckpt(key) total = m.cases.count() if start >= total p(phase, "skip", "already-complete") return end if
for i = start to total - 1 c = m.cases[i] setCkpt(key, i + 1) if only.count() > 0 and not inList(only, c.id) p(phase, c.id, "skipped not-in-subset") else p(phase, c.id, "begin sig=" + c.sig + " field=" + fieldName) m.result = "<not-called>" m.top.unobserveField(fieldName) m.top.unobserveFieldScoped(fieldName) if scoped m.top.observeFieldScoped(fieldName, c.cb) else m.top.observeField(fieldName, c.cb) end if
thrown = "" try m.trig = m.trig + 1 if fieldName = "probeTriggerStr" m.top.probeTriggerStr = "v" + itos(m.trig) else m.top.probeTrigger = m.trig end if catch e thrown = errText(e) end try
m.top.unobserveField(fieldName) m.top.unobserveFieldScoped(fieldName) p(phase, c.id, "end " + m.result + " throw={" + thrown + "}") end if end for p(phase, "done", "") end sub
' Timer `fire` axis - one case per stepTimer tick. sub onStep() if m.p2pending done = m.cases[m.p2 - 1] p("p2-timer-fire", done.id, "end " + m.result) m.p2pending = false end if
if m.p2 >= m.cases.count() p("p2-timer-fire", "done", "") finish() return end if
c = m.cases[m.p2] m.p2 = m.p2 + 1 setCkpt("p2next", m.p2) p("p2-timer-fire", c.id, "begin sig=" + c.sig + " field=fire")
m.result = "<not-called>" m.caseTimer.unobserveField("fire") m.caseTimer.observeField("fire", c.cb) m.caseTimer.control = "start" m.p2pending = true end sub
sub finish() m.stepTimer.control = "stop" m.reg.Delete("p1-observeField-next") m.reg.Delete("p3-scopedObserve-next") m.reg.Delete("p4-stringField-next") m.reg.Delete("p2next") m.reg.Flush() p("all", "done", "checkpoints-cleared") m.top.probeExit = true end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Probe callbacks - one per declared-signature shape under test. ' Each body is wrapped in try/catch so an <uninitialized> parameter is reported, not fatal. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sub cbA() rec("bound=0") end sub
sub cbB(e) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbC(e as object) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbD(e as dynamic) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
' Required, and an roSGNodeEvent can never satisfy it. sub cbE(s as string) try rec("p1=" + d(s)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
' The JellyRock reportPlayback shape: optional, typed string, with a default. sub cbF(s = "update" as string) try rec("p1=" + d(s)) rec("cmp-stop=" + btos(s = "stop")) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbG(n as integer) try rec("p1=" + d(n)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbH(n = 42 as integer) try rec("p1=" + d(n)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbI(e, opt = true) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("p1-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try try rec("p2=" + d(opt)) catch err rec("p2-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbJ(a, b) try rec("p1=" + d(a)) catch err rec("p1-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try try rec("p2=" + d(b)) catch err rec("p2-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbK(s = "update" as string, e = invalid as object) try rec("p1=" + d(s)) catch err rec("p1-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try try rec("p2=" + d(e)) catch err rec("p2-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbL(b as boolean) try rec("p1=" + d(b)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbM(e as object, s = "update" as string) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("p1-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try try rec("p2=" + d(s)) catch err rec("p2-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
sub cbN(e = invalid as object) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
function cbO(e as object) as string try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("body-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try return "returned-value-ignored" end function
sub cbP(e as object, s as string) try rec("p1=" + d(e)) catch err rec("p1-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try try rec("p2=" + d(s)) catch err rec("p2-error={" + errText(err) + "}") end try end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sub rec(text as string) if m.result = "<not-called>" m.result = text else m.result = m.result + " " + text end if end sub
' Describe any value: its type() plus a readable rendering, never throwing. function d(v as dynamic) as string t = "?" try t = type(v) catch err return "<unreadable:" + errText(err) + ">" end try
if t = "roSGNodeEvent" return "roSGNodeEvent{field=" + v.getField() + " data=" + d(v.getData()) + "}" else if t = "String" or t = "roString" return "String{" + v + "}" else if t = "Integer" or t = "roInt" or t = "roInteger" or t = "LongInteger" or t = "roLongInteger" return t + "{" + str(v).trim() + "}" else if t = "Float" or t = "roFloat" or t = "Double" or t = "roDouble" return t + "{" + str(v).trim() + "}" else if t = "Boolean" or t = "roBoolean" return t + "{" + btos(v) + "}" else if t = "roSGNode" return "roSGNode{" + v.subtype() + "}" end if return "<" + t + ">" end function
function btos(b as dynamic) as string if b = true then return "true" return "false" end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
function errText(e as object) as string if type(e) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return "<non-aa-error>" msg = "" if e.message <> invalid then msg = e.message if e.number <> invalid then msg = msg + " (#" + str(e.number).trim() + ")" return msg end function
function inList(arr as object, id as string) as boolean for each item in arr if item = id then return true end for return false end function
function ckpt(key as string) as integer if m.reg.Exists(key) then return int(val(m.reg.Read(key))) return 0 end function
sub setCkpt(key as string, value as integer) m.reg.Write(key, itos(value)) m.reg.Flush() end sub
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
